cohort: 227,052 women from the Consortium on Safe Labor (CSL) database
finding: In this large cohort of women diagnosed with preeclampsia prior to labor, the rate of intrapartum chorioamnionitis was decreased and the rate of postpartum infectious morbidity was not higher compared to women without a diagnosis of preeclampsia.
mod_finding: While the rate of wound infection was higher in women with preeclampsia, mode of delivery was adjusted for in the analysis and was not found to be independently associated with preeclampsia.
